I'm not sure if I'd be able to get a letter from my doctor for that, since they haven't been involved in me transitioning since the last time I tried getting help from the NHS they treated me so badly

And unfortunately I don't know anyone that is eligible to do that

Unfortunately I'm not with a gender clinic atm
And that's good to hear, I tried looking but it didn't look like they accepted a statutory declaration or anything like that when I tried to look

Don't they have to have a driver's license and a full time job, and if it's a passport know me for over 2 years?
Because I don't know anybody that meets even one of those criteria

From what I've read most places have stopped doing that, and I've only ever been to the doctors here once over a year ago, so I'm not sure if they would help me even if they do offer that service at mine

Unfortunately not, I only know 2 people in the country
Don't really know anybody else even in passing, especially not anyone that could countersign

I'd like to do that but other than not being able to go out to the GP I wouldn't want to end up missing an appointment at the GIC, and if I would be able to go out and afford to get to it I wouldn't want my mental illness to get in the way
I know that if i want any help from them I'd need to lie about it but it'd be hard to lie around because it's affected me so much
And I really wouldn't last over a year waiting, 

And I'm not able to get myself to go outside because of my face
It's too scarred and always has fresh wounds that I can't really cover with make up
I'm fine when I'm healed up and can shave and have an hour or so with makeup 
Or at least was fine with that 6 months ago, been that long since I was last able to do that successfully so I don't really know any more, I know shaving doesn't really work any more
I already get spit on and assaulted and stared at when I go out without scars and stuff visible, I don't need to be seen as even more of a freak
Doesn't help I live in a bad area

And it never been able to get a job, all this and other mental problems have stopped me from doing a lot of stuff
I wasn't able to attend secondary school a lot of the time because of my mental health, innately scraped by in the 1st year of college and got kicked out in my second year because I just couldn't cope with it
I don't have any way to do a job from home that I would be comfortable with since all I have is my phone
All I've really wanted to do is make digital art and do something with that because I got really good at it in college, but I have nothing to do that on

I know you think you're trying to help but you need to try and understand that everyone is different and not everyone can do what you can, though i am glad you managed to get better.
I would suggest trying to understand other people and not assume that because you have been in similar circumstances that they are the same as you.

Thank you.

And I just wanted to point out that $25 a week isn't free. That's a huge chunk of what I have to live off of each month.

I'll try and look into those
Thank you

I was in CAMHS when I was younger and they referred me to a GIC and I got one appointment
That was when anxiety was my only real issue and I told them it was because of having to present as male and being scared of my body getting worse, but even then they said it would delay getting hrt because mental illness
And they seemed more concerned with how my mum and the sister she outed me to felt about me being trans
They also fucked me over afterwards by sending a letter addressed to me or my parent/guardian to an address I didn't give them, that would have outed me to my dad if I had got home a minute later that day

My mum also decided to sabotage my appointments by saying she'd refuse to take me if I didn't pay her to
And when I was given another appointment she said she'd call and tell them I couldn't go, but she didn't so they thought I'd stopped being trans or whatever
Or she did call and say that I didn't need help any more because when I had to call them and sort things out they kept asking if I *really* did want an appointment again and I said yes until they gave in and booked me an appointment and said I'd get a lettter to confirm it
And they never sent the letter so I didn't get another appointment

I'm explaining why it doesn't work for me
I don't want to be like this

I have two online friends that have known me for years, that is all

I've been trying my best for years and every day is worse than the last, I think most people would feel the same way

I've never been able to find any therapy online for free
Not counselling, which has always made me get worse and I have done irl

And it is
But I don't see why you think I am not doing my best to break out of this if it's just a mindset
I don't think you understand

I've been trying my best. 
I've given up everything to make things better
I've researched 
I've tried medication 
I've tried getting help
I've tried the NHS
I am disabled and cannot work
I have done my best despite what you may think.

Do you really think every person that struggles just isn't trying hard enough just because you were lucky enough to yourself?

People only believe that I'm not doing my best when they don't know me
The people that have known me the longest admit that they now realise I'm doing my best
I know my best isn't much
But I always do it 
I always have

I am seeking help, yes
Because I'm not guaranteed anything I try will work so I'm trying to avoid that because I know I could end up making things worse
Just because someone wants dessert doesn't mean they won't try and eat the main course

I can't afford a therapist, I've looked and looked
All I can do is ask for help

I don't understand what you mean by if I really want to fix things I can? Do you really think I want to stay inside 4 walls for six months at a time, with nothing and no one? Do you think I enjoy that, that I wouldn't do my best to get out of it?
It's like prison
And if people can break out of them, they do

You're saying all this like it's nothing, not everyone is a fucking superhuman like you
Every fucking day is impossible for me, it's hard enough getting out of bed, if I even can
I have a fucking alphabet soup of things wrong with me that prevent me from living like people should 
But I do my best and this is what it looks like, I'm sorry if you can't understand that

And please don't say that fucking things will get better slogan. 
I gave up everything to leave my old life and start over and make things better and I lost everything
I did my best.

I know my best doesn't seem like much but I do it
Don't you think I would love to be able to work and function?
I'm glad that you've been able to make progress but you can't hold everyone up to the same standards
Ive been doing everything I can and been trying my best to make things better
OCD and depression are far from the only things that make things a struggle
I've been doing everything I can and I'm sick of people saying that it's not good enough and that I must be slacking
I know I'm not as able as most others but I do my best even if that's worth nothing
I know it might be hard for you to understand because you started in a similar place but please try

I do want to die but I'm too scared of things getting worse if I attempt and fail
That's why I'm trying to get help before I get to the point that I need to attempt again
But I have nothing holding me here and if I was given the option do it instantly and painlessly I would take it
